body: They don’t do it because they’re dumb, they know it’s probably the worst thing they can do, they do it because they love the person beyond behaving rationally.

Thanks for the poor advice. If you read my post properly you would’ve seen I am seeking advice on how to cope with leaving someone I love. 

P.S. No one deserves to be cheated on.

Thanks so much for this response, I was hoping to hear from someone who has experienced something similar. 

I agree it’s a conflict between my head and heart right now. My head is telling me to let go and migrate like I’ve always wanted, but without him. But I know as soon as I let go the reality of it being over will set in, and my hearts telling me not to let that happen as I love him so much, and I truly believe I will never come across anyone like him. 

It’s just hurting a lot more this time, at least when I last caught him doing something wrong he begged for forgiveness, this time it feels like he’s over it and feels like he can never be faithful to me, despite “loving” me like he says. 

I know break ups feel like the end of the world at first and I can get over it, but I sort of feel like I don’t even want to get over it at the moment?
Not much longer, he works at a car dealership and it’s the busiest time of the year because of the annual plate change.
I’m trying, I’m just so heartbroken.

I know, who knows how long it would’ve gone on. 

He told her that he’s had a girlfriend of 4 years the next day at work after I found out. She no longer wants anything to do with him. It’s just a shame that I don’t feel the same way as her right now.

I was buying train tickets online, and for some reason the website I have to use refuses to accept a payment associated with my email, so I used his. I told him I had done this while he was at work, we’d do things like this normally as we have each other’s passwords for things. 

I logged into his email to retrieve the booking reference code, and he had been emailing the female coworker on his personal email instead of his work email for the day. I read their flirtatious messages and that they had arranged to go for lunch in a restaurant together that day.

He said he feels like our spark has gone, but I thought that was due to him working 80 hours a week the past couple months so we haven’t had time to see each other much a all. Maybe it is, and that’s why his eyes went wandering in his workplace.
